Messages.Author: Omelet
Messages.Body:
If Uta Kovacs uses Clan Impersonation to switch to Tremere and equips the Ankara Citadel Turkey, how is the cost of THA cards calculated.

Uta

> Sabbat: Uta can enter combat with a minion controlled by another Methuselah as a  action. Cards that require Thaumaturgy cost her 1 less blood.
>
Ankara Citadel, Turkey

> This equipment card represents a location and does not count as equipment while in play. Unique.
> Cards that cost blood cost this vampire half as much blood to play (round down).
>
It seems that either effect you apply first leads to the same outcome...

If a card costs two blood, Ankara reduces to one, and the special reduces by 1 for zero cost OR special reduces by 1, ankara reduces by 0.5, round down to zero.

Is this correct?

Messages.Author: jhattara
Messages.Body:
> RTR wrote:
> All cost-affecting cards operate no matter how the card is played ("as normal" or otherwise). All multiplication and division is handled first, followed by addition and subtraction.
>
If Uta Kovacs has Ankara Citadel and plays a Thaumaturgy card that costs 3 blood or less, she pays 0 (3/2 = 1.5 rounded down to 1 -1 = 0). If the card costs 5 blood, she pays 1 (5/2 = 2.5 rounded down to 2 -1 = 1). And so forth.
